principles: Beauty, capability and dignity should not be premium features.
Architecture and ecosystem coherence may be inspired by Apple; visuals must remain an original edenOS design.
Simple to deploy. Useful immediately. Fully upgradeable. Fully customizable.
Use ordinary human language in the UI; avoid exposing internal framework names.
Experience depth is a persistent user choice; device adaptation is independent.
V1 relevance comes from explicit Areas/profiles; future contextual awareness belongs to HEIMDALL or later intelligence layers.
Low-cost hardware receives the same design quality and platform dignity, constrained only by genuine hardware capability.
